_readme: Greylock's own listing fields, read out of the archived captures in sources/wayback/raw by scratch/build-archive-cards.py. Three eras publish more than a name: the 1999-2001 frameset (year funded, product, status line), the 2001-2003 ASP site (focus, status, year) and the 2005-2010 ColdFusion site (website, status, year funded, the Greylock partner on the deal, region). wayback-pull's listing_regex keeps slug and name only, so these columns would otherwise be discarded by the layer best placed to supply them -- status for a book whose dead rows never reached the press, and first_seen for the pre-window slice that has no Form D. Membership still comes from the wayback layer; this is a classification input, and the site's status wording is evidence for the judge, never a label.
